rationale:
Evidence. The verified best is iteration 6 (score 69.30). Its raced controller was kp 7.0, kd 0.3, ki 0.02, base_speed 1.0, last_direction, with the 7-sensor array at x = -0.075 to 0.075 (0.025 m spacing), y 0.06, footprint 0.016, mass 0.6, wheel_track 0.12. Oval progress was 0.242 and steering_oscillation 0.168. S-bend progress (0.1425) and slalom progress (0.1025) were flat across kp 5.5 to 7.0, and kp 8.0 (iteration 7) dropped oval progress to 0.196 and the score to 63.45. Every trial ended off track at max_error about 0.06.

Corrections. The round-2 revision says iteration 6 used kd 0.4 and ki 0. The raced record shows kd 0.3 and ki 0.02, so its baseline is wrong. I restart from the true raced values. The round-2 critique is right on four points: the kd 0.4 noise cost was never estimated, the 0.2 oscillation gate sits close to the raced 0.168, the oval is the only track that moved, and the middle band of the decision rule was undefined. I accept all four.

What I accepted and rejected. I reject the revision's kd 0.4 and ki 0 as the baseline, and the critique's point that the drift is steady so damping cannot fix it: damping does not address a steady offset, but oscillation and max_error under a gain change are the only measured effects I have. I accept that kd is a weak lever for the s-bend and slalom, which look like a start or entry event. I reject kp 8.5 (the revision's value, which was not raced) and any speed change, because speed would confound a gain test and completion is out of reach at speed 1.0 anyway.

What I changed. One variable against the true best: kd 0.3 to 0.5 (+67 percent). I choose 0.5, not the revision's 0.6, to limit derivative noise amplification, which the critique estimated as the main risk. ki stays 0.02, kp stays 7.0, and geometry, weights, base_speed and line loss are unchanged.

Predictions (guesses). Oval progress 0.24 to 0.27. S-bend progress about 0.14 and slalom about 0.10, because kd is not expected to move the entry event. steering_oscillation 0.17 to 0.22. Line_loss_events on the slalom at 1 or fewer.

Decision rule, applied to the seed mean on each track. Keep kd 0.5 if oval progress is at least 0.26 and oscillation is under 0.2 with no rise in max_error. If oval progress is 0.24 to 0.26 with oscillation under 0.2, keep kd 0.5 but do not count it as a gain. If progress falls below 0.24 or oscillation is above 0.2, revert to kd 0.3 (iteration 6). If s-bend stays at 0.14 and slalom at 0.10, the next iteration changes the start or the line-loss rule (search_left or search_right) and does not touch the gains. The oval per-seed spread (about 97 to 117 score) is large, so no single seed decides the rule.

This race tests stability and progress, not completion.
